sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Singh,Hitesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with prayer to direct the learned Civil Judge (S.D.)-II, Bareilly to decide the Case No. 2325 of 2019 (State vs. Vinod and Others) arising out of Case Crime No. 64 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Meerganj, District Bareilly expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: Case No. 2325 of 2019 (State vs. Vinod and Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the matter is pending consideration before the court concerned.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the application stands disposed of finally.
